integrity: An analytical finite-dimensional proof is accompanied by exact rational checks; no claim of external or independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Positive real weights for infinite averages; positive integer weights for exact finite windows, budget, and two-adic claims. The frequency unit is fixed. title: Sharp uniform-averaging design for anisotropically weighted hypercubes
